house.description: Individual income tax subtraction provided for discharges of indebtedness, and certain discharges of indebtedness excluded from income.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Taxes

latest_action.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Taxes

additions: The amount of discharge of indebtedness awarded to a claimant under section 332.74, subdivision 3, is a subtraction.
This section is effective for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2024.
(b) "Combined exemption amount" means the sum of:
(1) for the taxpayer's first dependent, the exemption amount multiplied by 1.4;
(2) for the taxpayer's second dependent, the exemption amount multiplied by 1.3;
(3) for the taxpayer's third dependent, the exemption amount multiplied by 1.2;
(4) for the taxpayer's fourth dependent, the exemption amount multiplied by 1.1;
(5) for the taxpayer's fifth dependent, the exemption amount; and
(6) if the taxpayer or taxpayer's spouse had a disability or attained the age of 65 on or before the close of the taxable year, the exemption amount.
